# PesaTrack

> A passive Android expense tracker for M-PESA and Kenyan bank SMS. Local-first, no cloud sync of transaction data, no ads, no third-party trackers unless you opt in.

PesaTrack reads incoming M-PESA and NCBA bank SMS messages on your Android device, extracts the transaction amount, recipient, date, and transaction code, and stores them in a local Room database. Transaction data is never transmitted off-device. Users get automatic categorisation, budgets, analytics, and Excel/PDF statement import — all offline. Optional anonymous usage analytics (Firebase) is off by default.

Made in Kenya. Free on Google Play.
